name: 80s Film: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the 80s Film look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, 1980s movie still shot on 35mm film, anamorphic lens, practical effects, feathered hair and period wardrobe, visible film grain, neon pink and cyan against deep shadow, backlit haze, lens flares, tungsten interiors, slow dolly and crane moves, smoke drifting through backlight, anamorphic flares sweeping across the lens
negative_prompt: modern clothing, smartphone, digital sharpness, cgi, hdr, clean skin smoothing, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
